name: Disintegrate
summary: Fires a green ray that deals heavy Force damage and turns a creature it kills to dust.

stats.effect:
You launch a green ray at a target you can see within range. The target can be a creature, a nonmagical object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by *{ref:spell/wall-of-force}.*

A creature targeted by this spell makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d6 + 40 Force damage. If this damage reduces it to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points}, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are disintegrated into gray dust. The target can be revived only by a *{ref:spell/true-resurrection}* or a *{ref:spell/wish}* spell.

This spell automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force. If such a target is Huge or larger, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-Cube portion of it.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 3d6 for each spell slot level above 6.
